title: machine: add part body placement transform and user machine-models directory lookup

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Extend the `.mch` part `body` schema (`#2591`) with per-part 6-DOF placement transforms and a user machine-models directory lookup.

## Context
`crates/sim/src/machine_model/mod.rs` places the spindle nose at `(0, 0, 0)` with `+Z` up along the spindle (ISO 841), and `crates/sim/src/machine_model/pose.rs` applies translation `offset` only. Vendor machine CAD files commonly use Y-up SolidWorks frames or floor-center Onshape origins, and vendor licences forbid bundling those files inside CamCraft.

## Scope
- Extend `#2591`'s per-part `body` schema in `camcraft-post::machine` and `crates/app/src/machine/validate.rs` with optional `offset` (`[x, y, z]` in `.mch` length units), `rotation` (`[rx, ry, rz]` in degrees), and `cad_pose` (joint reference value at CAD export pose).
- Extend `crates/sim/src/machine_model/pose.rs` to apply the 6-DOF local body transform (`offset` and `rotation`) and `cad_pose` shift per part.
- Add a pure folder resolver for local machine models matching `crates/app/src/machine/store.rs` and `crates/app/src/fixture_library/store.rs`: `CAMCRAFT_MACHINE_MODELS`, else `<platform data dir>/camcraft/machine-models`.
- Support an optional per-machine sidecar map file inside that folder so shipped `.mch` files stay unmodified.
- Refuse unknown keys, non-finite numbers, path traversal (`..`), and unreadable files by part ID and key. Fall back to generated `#2584` bodies with a named note when no local model exists.

## Done means
Tests pin schema parsing, named refusals, Y-up to Z-up rotation, spindle-nose alignment with `cad_pose`, `CAMCRAFT_MACHINE_MODELS` resolution order across platforms, and clean fallback with a named note when a local file is absent.

Depends on #2591.

Part of #3239
